chunks: So leave them to their vain disputes and amusement till they meet their day (of reckoning) promised them,

key_terms.يَخُوضُوا: to engage in vain or idle discourse
key_terms.يَلْعَبُوا: to play or amuse themselves (with mockery)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the idle talk of disbelievers regarding the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the strategic patience (sabr) of the Prophet and the faithful, emphasizing that divine retribution is inevitable despite current mockery. It serves as a spiritual anchor, reminding believers that the 'Day they are promised' is not merely a future event but a certainty that validates the truth of the message against contemporary skeptics.
